claims: Jon Scheyer is the head coach of the Duke University men's basketball team.
Jon Scheyer has been the head coach of the Duke University men's basketball team since the 2022-23 season.
Mike Krzyzewski is a Hall of Fame coach.
Jon Scheyer became head coach following the retirement of Mike Krzyzewski.
Jon Scheyer was a Duke player from 2006 to 2010.
Jon Scheyer was an assistant coach.
Jon Scheyer led the Blue Devils to three straight Sweet Sixteen appearances (2024-2026).
Jon Scheyer secured multiple top-three recruiting classes.
